subject.title: feat(ui): clickable file links in chat with a workspace file viewer sidebar

question: Should `sessions.files.get` intentionally expand from transcript-touched session files to any fs-safe file under the session workspace root, given current main also has `agents.workspace.*` under `operator.read`?
rationale: The implementation keeps containment and preview caps, but it changes what an existing read-scoped session method can retrieve; automation should not approve that boundary without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve bounded session-workspace reads
options.body: Accept the current read-scope direction after the Markdown line-target bug is fixed, relying on fs-safe containment, symlink/hardlink rejection, and the preview cap.

options.title: Narrow the session method
options.body: Keep chat file links and transcript-touched previews, but avoid expanding `sessions.files.get` beyond files with session relevance until a separate contract is chosen.

options.title: Consolidate on workspace APIs first
options.body: Pause this PR and decide whether session UI should use or extend the newer `agents.workspace.*` contract instead of widening `sessions.files.*`.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded session-workspace reads
recommendation.body: Accept the current read-scope direction after the Markdown line-target bug is fixed, relying on fs-safe containment, symlink/hardlink rejection, and the preview cap.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the current product proposal and have the strongest recent adjacent history on the workspace read/API direction.
